Photo: the same mother helping her schoolboy son with homework at the warm kitchen table, preserve likeness and natural connection. Photo realism, believable anatomy/hands, all four scenes present once, no duplicated people/limbs, no collage seam cutting through faces. Avoid glossy 3D, pills/buttons, shopping cards, intense blues/neon, excessive decoration. This must visually continue the approved family-morning DIRECTION while showing only the second section; the design itself awaits approval. FORMAT: a tall DESKTOP webpage section, logical width 1440, about 1800-2100px section height, vertical export with wide desktop composition. Four full-width editorial story strips in a continuous canvas: work photo broad LEFT/text RIGHT, movement text LEFT/photo RIGHT, family photo LEFT/text RIGHT, garden text LEFT/photo RIGHT. Photos have clean broad soft curved boundaries flowing into cream text areas; do not put them inside rounded cards. Alternate image/text with generous typographic hierarchy, concise readable paragraphs, a small 02 eyebrow above the intro. Match the source layout closely after removing its entire first hero. Keep text panels at a comfortable 38-42% of row width, photographs 58-62%, enough air around headings. This is one section extending through several viewport heights, not a claim that everything fits one screen.
